verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's NetHSM ships a container image (docker.io/nitrokey/nethsm:testing) that users can run on their own infrastructure, so a self-hostable server form of the product exists. The docs restrict that image to testing and development and forbid production use. The USB keys are local devices with fully open-source firmware and installable tagged releases, which is user-controlled rather than vendor-hosted. Missing for 10: a documented production-grade self-hosted deployment (container or on-prem install guide for production NetHSM), and hands-on or independent corroboration of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
